title: Ice creature
placement: 64 x 64 frames. Bottom-centre origin (32, 64). Manual rectangular collision mask, fixed across all frames. Mask bottom 63 is virtual ground contact; artwork hovers above it. Flying/floating movement requires game code. PNG files do not store origin, speed or collision settings.

exportRevision.method: Common transparent-top crop, proportional Lanczos downscale, bottom-centred transparent canvas. Same transform across all variants.
